Tatiana Maslany and Jasmin Savoy Brown to Star in Sci-Fi Horror Green Bank

The upcoming sci-fi horror film Green Bank is quickly gaining momentum, with Emmy-winning actress Tatiana Maslany and Scream star Jasmin Savoy Brown leading the cast. As international sales launch at the European Film Market (EFM) in Berlin, Green Bank is shaping up to be one of the most anticipated horror projects currently in development.

A Star-Studded Cast Leading Green Bank

Green Bank brings together two standout performers known for their work in genre storytelling:

  • Tatiana Maslany, acclaimed for her Emmy-winning performance in Orphan Black and her role in Marvel’s She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
  • Jasmin Savoy Brown, best known for Scream and Showtime’s Yellowjackets

Their involvement immediately elevates the project, signaling a strong mix of talent and audience appeal.

What Is Green Bank About?

Written by Aaron Horwitz (The Cleansing Hour), Green Bank is set in a real American town where all forms of wireless communication—Wi-Fi, cell service, and radio signals—are strictly banned.

The story follows:

  • Sloan, an infant sleep trainer played by Jasmin Savoy Brown
  • As she begins working for a family in this isolated town, she discovers that the parents may be hiding something far more sinister than they initially appear

This unique, technology-free setting adds an unsettling layer of tension, making Green Bank a fresh entry into the sci-fi horror genre.

The Team Behind Green Bank

The film is directed by Josh Ruben, known for his ability to blend horror with humor. His previous credits include:

  • Scare Me (Sundance Film Festival)
  • Werewolves Within (Tribeca Film Festival, award-winning indie hit)

Producing the film is Andy Horwitz of Big Swell Entertainment, whose past projects include American Hustle, Suicide Squad, and Triple Frontier.

Protagonist Pictures is handling international sales, while CAA Media Finance and UTA Independent Film Group are representing North American rights.

Who Are the Casting Directors for Green Bank?

Casting is a vital part of bringing Green Bank’s eerie world to life, especially with a story that centers around both adult and child performances. One of the casting teams attached to the project is C2 Kids, a casting company known for its expertise in working with young talent.

C2 Kids plays a key role in identifying and developing child actors who can handle emotionally complex and high-stakes scenes—an essential component for a suspense-driven film like Green Bank. Their involvement highlights the production’s commitment to building a strong and believable cast from top to bottom.

As more casting details are revealed, the film is expected to continue assembling a dynamic mix of established actors and emerging talent.

Why Green Bank Is Generating Buzz

Horror remains one of the most reliable genres at the box office, and Green Bank taps into that demand with a compelling concept and tone. The film promises:

  • A smart and suspenseful storyline
  • A balance of scares and dark humor
  • A unique setting that sets it apart from traditional horror films

With audiences continuing to seek original and entertaining theatrical experiences, Green Bank is positioned to deliver exactly that.

Spotlight on the Lead Stars

Tatiana Maslany

Maslany has built an impressive résumé with standout roles in:

  • Orphan Black
  • Perry Mason
  • Stronger
  • She-Hulk: Attorney at Law

Jasmin Savoy Brown

Brown continues to rise in Hollywood with performances in:

  • Scream franchise
  • Yellowjackets
  • The Leftovers
  • For the People

Her growing presence in the horror genre makes her a perfect fit for Green Bank.

item.content:encoded:
Key Takeaways

  • Anne Hathaway addressed ongoing facelift rumors in a new interview with Elle
  • The actress said online speculation about her appearance became “distracting”
  • Hathaway clarified that a recent “lifted” look came from a braided hairstyle—not surgery
  • She also admitted she may consider cosmetic procedures in the future

Anne Hathaway Speaks Out About Appearance Rumors

Anne Hathaway is finally responding to the online speculation surrounding her appearance.

The Oscar-winning actress recently addressed persistent facelift rumors during a candid interview with Elle, explaining why she felt compelled to break her silence after months of social media discussion about her youthful look.

According to Hathaway, the rumors became impossible to ignore.

“The speculation has gotten so loud that you do feel the need to just get your truth out there,” she explained.

What Sparked the Rumors

The conversation intensified after Hathaway shared a beauty tutorial showcasing a braided hairstyle that created a more lifted appearance on the red carpet.

Some online users quickly assumed the actress had undergone cosmetic surgery.

Hathaway pushed back against those assumptions, emphasizing that people were jumping to conclusions about deeply personal medical decisions.

“These are huge medical decisions that people are presuming,” she said. “No, I didn’t make a huge medical decision. It’s just two braids.”

Could Plastic Surgery Be in Her Future?

While denying recent surgery rumors, Hathaway also acknowledged that she isn’t ruling out cosmetic procedures entirely.

“By the way, I might still get a facelift someday,” she admitted during the interview.

Her honesty sparked discussion online, with many fans praising the actress for addressing beauty standards and aging openly.

Reflecting on Fame and Self-Criticism

Beyond the speculation, Hathaway also reflected on the emotional pressure she experienced earlier in her career.

The actress shared that fear and insecurity once made her overly critical of herself.

“One of the things about younger me is she was really scared,” Hathaway explained. “I think that fear made me harsh with myself.”

She added that looking back on those years now makes her reconsider how self-criticism can affect personal growth and relationships.

Hathaway’s Definition of Beauty

Hathaway has increasingly spoken about authenticity and confidence in recent interviews.

In a previous conversation, she described beauty as something connected to truth rather than perfection.

The actress also admitted that navigating beauty standards in Hollywood wasn’t always easy, recalling years of confusion over hair and styling choices early in her career.

Why This Matters in Hollywood

Hathaway’s comments reflect a growing conversation in the entertainment industry about beauty standards, aging, and online scrutiny.

Actors and public figures often face intense speculation about their appearance, especially on social media, where rumors can quickly spread without confirmation.

Her decision to address the topic directly highlights the pressure many performers face while balancing public image with personal privacy.

Final Thoughts

As discussions about beauty and cosmetic procedures continue across Hollywood, Anne Hathaway’s candid response offers a reminder that public assumptions don’t always reflect reality.

Whether through honesty, humor, or transparency, the actress continues to navigate fame on her own terms—while encouraging a more thoughtful conversation around appearance and aging in the entertainment industry.

item.content:encoded:
Key Takeaways

  • Quentin Tarantino reportedly warned Brad Pitt after an on-set mistake during filming
  • Bruce Dern recalled Pitt accidentally “cutting the camera” during a scene
  • Tarantino told Pitt that stopping a scene was strictly the director’s responsibility
  • Brad Pitt is set to return as Cliff Booth in an upcoming Netflix spinoff

Bruce Dern Reveals Tense Moment on Set

A surprising behind-the-scenes story from Once Upon a Time in Hollywood is giving fans a closer look at Quentin Tarantino’s directing style.

Veteran actor Bruce Dern recently recalled a tense moment involving Brad Pitt during production of the 2019 hit film. According to Dern, Pitt interrupted filming during an improvised scene—prompting a serious response from Tarantino.

What Happened During Filming

Dern explained that the moment occurred while filming a scene between his character, George Spahn, and Pitt’s Cliff Booth.

As Dern improvised dialogue during the take, Pitt reportedly stopped filming mid-scene.

“He cut the camera,” Dern recalled.

According to the actor, Tarantino immediately reacted with a stern warning.

“Never again in your life will you ever cut a camera or you’ll be dead in this business. That’s my domain,” Tarantino reportedly told Pitt.

The director emphasized that actors should continue performing rather than interrupting the flow of a scene.

Improvisation and Creative Tension

The scene was eventually reshot, though Dern noted that Pitt questioned changes that weren’t originally included in the script.

The moment highlights Tarantino’s well-known passion for spontaneous performances and uninterrupted scene work—something many actors admire about his filmmaking process.

Dern later improvised another line that ultimately stayed in the movie.

Brad Pitt Returning as Cliff Booth

Despite the tense on-set memory, Pitt is officially returning as Cliff Booth in an upcoming Netflix spinoff connected to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.

While Tarantino wrote the screenplay, acclaimed director David Fincher will helm the project.

The film is expected to receive a limited IMAX release beginning November 25.

Why Tarantino Isn’t Directing the Spinoff

Tarantino recently explained that he chose not to direct the project himself because he wanted his final film to explore “uncharted territory.”

The filmmaker has repeatedly stated that he plans to retire after directing his tenth feature film.

Although he stepped away from directing duties, Tarantino praised Fincher as the ideal filmmaker to continue the story.

Why This Matters for Actors

The story offers an important reminder about film set etiquette and the collaborative nature of production.

For actors, understanding the boundaries between performance and technical direction is essential when working on professional sets—especially with highly detail-oriented directors.

It also highlights how improvisation can sometimes create memorable moments, even amid creative tension.

Final Thoughts

As anticipation grows for the Cliff Booth spinoff, stories from the set of Once Upon a Time in Hollywood continue to fascinate fans and industry professionals alike.

The exchange between Tarantino and Pitt serves as a rare glimpse into the high standards and creative dynamics behind one of Hollywood’s most celebrated modern films.

item.content:encoded:
Key Takeaways

  • Nicolas Cage considered retiring after Dream Scenario
  • The Oscar-winning actor felt he had “said everything” with cinema
  • Cage decided to explore television and possibly stage acting
  • He stars in Amazon Prime Video’s upcoming Spider-Noir series
  • Cage says completing a TV season gave him new creative energy

Nicolas Cage Thought About Leaving Hollywood After Dream Scenario

Nicolas Cage has revealed he seriously considered retiring from acting after his critically praised performance in Dream Scenario.

The Hollywood veteran admitted he reached a creative crossroads following the 2023 comedy-drama and wasn’t sure what direction his career should take next.

In a recent interview with Extra, Cage explained that he felt creatively exhausted after the film.

“I was thinking along those lines after Dream Scenario because I didn’t know what else I could do with cinema.”

The actor added that he questioned whether he had already accomplished everything he wanted in movies.

“I got to a point after Dream Scenario where I was just like, you know, I think I’ve said everything I’ve had to say with cinema.”

Why Nicolas Cage Decided Not to Retire

Although Cage considered stepping away from acting, he ultimately decided to keep going — partly out of necessity and partly out of curiosity.

The actor said he began looking for new creative challenges outside traditional film roles.

“I thought, all right, let’s try something else. So it’s, what’s next? Television. What’s next? Maybe stage.”

That mindset led Cage to his first major television role in Amazon Prime Video’s upcoming superhero noir series Spider-Noir.

The show features Cage playing both Spider-Man Noir and his alternate alter-ego Ben Reilly, marking a major new chapter in his decades-long career.

Spider-Noir Gave Cage New Creative Energy

According to Cage, working on a television series completely changed his perspective as an actor.

The Oscar winner admitted the experience was far more demanding than he expected.

“I felt like, ‘Wow, I actually did it. I got through a season of television.’ It’s not easy.”

Cage explained that television production requires actors to constantly adapt because of rotating directors and fast-paced schedules.

“You have different directors. It’s almost like a factory dynamic and you’ve got to fit in that and you’ve got to make it work and still be amusing and entertaining.”

Despite the challenges, the experience reinvigorated him creatively and gave him confidence to continue exploring new formats.

Nicolas Cage Open to Broadway and Stage Acting

Cage also hinted that theater could be part of his future.

While discussing what comes next in his career, the actor said he remains open to performing on Broadway or taking on stage roles.

“You can never say never.”

For longtime fans, the idea of Cage bringing his intense acting style to live theater could become one of Hollywood’s most exciting future possibilities.

Nicolas Cage’s Career Resurgence Continues

Over the past several years, Cage has experienced a major career resurgence thanks to acclaimed performances in independent films and genre projects.

Recent standout performances include:

  • Pig
  • Dream Scenario
  • Longlegs
  • The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent

Critics and audiences alike have praised Cage for embracing bold, unpredictable roles that showcase his unique acting style.

His ability to move between emotional dramas, horror thrillers, surreal comedies, and blockbuster franchises continues to make him one of Hollywood’s most fascinating stars.

Cage Refuses to Be Typecast

Throughout his career, Nicolas Cage has intentionally avoided limiting himself to one type of role.

Speaking to People magazine, Cage explained that he enjoys playing both heroes and villains because variety keeps acting exciting.

“I’ve played plenty of villains. I like both.”

He continued:

“I think they’re both important parts of cinema. I would not want to get trapped into doing one thing.”

That willingness to experiment has defined Cage’s career since his early breakout roles in films like:

  • Leaving Las Vegas
  • Face/Off
  • National Treasure
  • Adaptation
  • Con Air

Why Fans Are Excited About Spider-Noir

The upcoming Spider-Noir series is already generating major buzz among comic book fans and television audiences.

The character first gained popularity through the animated hit Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, where Cage voiced the black-and-white version of Spider-Man inspired by 1930s detective stories.

Now, Cage will bring the character to live action for the first time.

The project also reflects a growing trend of major movie stars transitioning into streaming television, where creative storytelling opportunities continue expanding rapidly.

Hollywood Stars Increasingly Moving to Television

Cage’s move into television mirrors a larger industry shift.

More A-list actors are embracing streaming series because television now offers:

  • Longer character development
  • Prestige storytelling
  • Creative freedom
  • Global streaming audiences
  • Award-winning opportunities

Stars like Matthew McConaughey, Kate Winslet, Harrison Ford, and Nicole Kidman have all successfully crossed between film and television in recent years.

For Cage, Spider-Noir may mark the beginning of an entirely new phase in his career.

Final Thoughts

Nicolas Cage nearly retired after Dream Scenario, believing he had already accomplished everything he wanted in cinema. Instead, the legendary actor chose to challenge himself by entering the world of television with Spider-Noir.

The move appears to have reignited his passion for acting and opened the door to even more creative possibilities in the future.

Whether on the big screen, streaming television, or potentially Broadway someday, Cage continues proving why he remains one of entertainment’s most unpredictable and compelling performers.

item.content:encoded:
Key Takeaways

  • Snoop Dogg will star alongside Brandon Perea in The Faith of Long Beach
  • The movie follows a young street fighter chasing a professional boxing career
  • Snowfall writer Eric Amadio will write and direct the film
  • The project highlights Long Beach culture, struggle, redemption, and faith
  • Death Row Pictures is producing the upcoming boxing drama

Snoop Dogg Returns to Long Beach Roots in New Boxing Drama

Snoop Dogg is stepping back into his hometown spotlight with a major new film role. The hip-hop legend has officially joined Brandon Perea in the upcoming boxing drama The Faith of Long Beach.

The film, written and directed by Snowfall writer Eric Amadio, centers around a quiet but talented street fighter from Long Beach who dreams of escaping his troubled past. Raised in a group home, the young fighter struggles to leave behind dangerous backyard fights while trying to build a future in professional boxing.

The story blends sports drama with emotional themes of family, redemption, and perseverance — making it one of the most anticipated independent boxing films currently in development.

Brandon Perea Leads Emotional Boxing Story

Brandon Perea, best known for his breakout role in Jordan Peele’s Nope, will play the lead fighter in the movie. According to director Eric Amadio, Perea immediately stood out as the perfect actor to portray the film’s layered and emotionally complex main character.

Amadio described the project as much more than a traditional boxing movie.

“It’s about having faith in yourself when nobody else does,” Amadio explained.

The filmmaker also emphasized the importance of showcasing Long Beach culture authentically on screen.

“With Brandon, I knew instantly I had my nuanced, complicated fighter. And with Snoop, I’ve got the authentic OG who’s seen every version of that kid and still bets on him anyway.”

The movie aims to spotlight the real people, struggles, and spirit of Long Beach — a city deeply tied to Snoop Dogg’s personal and professional story.

Snoop Dogg Continues Expanding His Hollywood Career

While Snoop Dogg’s exact role in The Faith of Long Beach has not yet been revealed, his involvement already brings major attention to the project.

Snoop shared his excitement about the film in a statement:

“This is the type of story that hits different — heart, grit, struggle and redemption all wrapped up in that Long Beach spirit.”

The rap icon has steadily expanded his acting and producing career over the years. Fans have seen him appear in projects like:

  • BMF
  • Day Shift
  • Dolemite Is My Name
  • Starsky & Hutch
  • Soul Plane

Now, through Death Row Pictures, Snoop is also becoming a stronger force behind the scenes in film production.

Death Row Pictures Producing the Film

The project will be produced by:

  • Adonis Tountas for Everlast Pictures
  • Snoop Dogg
  • Sara Ramaker for Death Row Pictures

Interestingly, this film has been in development for several years. Back in 2022, actor and rapper Common was originally attached to star opposite Brandon Perea. However, the casting direction later changed, and Snoop Dogg officially stepped into the project.

Producer Adonis Tountas praised the collaboration and said Snoop’s connection to Long Beach makes him an essential part of telling the story authentically.

Boxing Movies Continue to Dominate Hollywood

The announcement arrives during a strong resurgence for boxing and fight-centered dramas in Hollywood. Audiences continue to embrace emotional sports stories that combine action with personal growth.

Recent hits like:

  • Creed III
  • The Iron Claw
  • Southpaw
  • Million Dollar Baby

have proven that boxing films remain popular with viewers worldwide.

The Faith of Long Beach appears ready to follow that trend while adding its own unique perspective rooted in Long Beach street culture and family struggles.

Snoop Dogg’s Upcoming Biopic Adds More Buzz

The news also comes shortly after Snoop Dogg appeared at CinemaCon to promote his upcoming Universal Pictures biopic.

The film will star Outer Banks actor Jonathan Daviss as Snoop Dogg and is expected to begin production in Los Angeles later this year. Snoop will also produce the project through his overall deal with NBCUniversal Entertainment.

With multiple film projects in motion, Snoop Dogg continues evolving from music superstar into a major Hollywood creative force.

Why This Movie Could Connect With Audiences

What makes The Faith of Long Beach stand out is its emotional core. Rather than focusing only on boxing, the film explores:

  • Youth struggling to escape difficult environments
  • Father-son relationships
  • Second chances
  • Community support
  • Believing in yourself during hardship

These themes often resonate strongly with audiences because they feel personal and relatable beyond sports.

The addition of Snoop Dogg also gives the movie cultural authenticity that could help it stand apart from other boxing dramas.

Final Thoughts

The Faith of Long Beach is shaping up to be a powerful sports drama filled with emotion, grit, and authentic Long Beach storytelling. With Brandon Perea leading the cast and Snoop Dogg bringing both star power and personal connection to the project, the film already has strong momentum.

As production moves forward, fans of boxing movies, coming-of-age stories, and Snoop Dogg alike will be watching closely for more updates.

James Bond Auditions Are Underway as Amazon MGM Begins Search for the Next 007

The search for the next James Bond has officially begun, and Hollywood is paying close attention.

Amazon MGM Studios confirmed that “the search for the next James Bond is underway,” adding that it does not plan to comment on specific details during the casting process but will share more news when the time is right. (007)

That short statement has already sparked a major debate among movie fans, actors, casting professionals, and entertainment insiders: Who should be the next 007?

Should Bond be played by a major star? A rising British actor? A complete unknown? Or should the franchise take a bold new direction?

For actors, this is more than just another celebrity casting rumor. The James Bond search is one of the biggest casting conversations in entertainment, and it shows how much one role can shape an actor’s entire career.

A New Era for James Bond

The next James Bond movie will mark a major turning point for the franchise.

Daniel Craig was the last actor to play Bond, ending his run with No Time to Die in 2021. Craig first stepped into the role in Casino Royale in 2006 and went on to star in five Bond films. (People.com)

Now, Amazon MGM Studios is preparing to introduce a new actor as the face of one of the most famous movie franchises in the world.

This will also be the first major Bond chapter since Amazon MGM gained creative control of future Bond projects through a new arrangement involving longtime Bond producers Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson. (People.com)

That makes this casting decision even bigger. The next actor will not just be replacing Daniel Craig. He will be helping define what James Bond looks and feels like for a new generation.

Who Is Working on the Next James Bond Movie?

The creative team behind the next Bond film is already coming together.

Denis Villeneuve, the filmmaker behind Dune, Arrival, and Blade Runner 2049, has been announced as the director of the next James Bond film. Amazon MGM Studios described him as a filmmaker known for immersive storytelling, bold visuals, and complex characters. (007)

Steven Knight, the creator of Peaky Blinders, is writing the script. Amazon MGM Studios confirmed that Knight’s hiring follows the announcements of Villeneuve as director and Amy Pascal and David Heyman as producers. (007)

Pascal and Heyman bring major franchise experience. Pascal is known for her work on the Spider-Man franchise, while Heyman produced all eight Harry Potter films. (007)

In other words, Amazon MGM appears to be building this next Bond film with a high-profile creative team. That makes the casting search even more important.

Nina Gold Is Reportedly Leading the Casting Search

According to Entertainment Weekly and other outlets, casting director Nina Gold is leading the search for the next James Bond. Gold has worked on major projects including Game of Thrones, Star Wars: The Force Awakens, Paddington, Prometheus, and Conclave. (EW.com)

That is a major detail because Bond casting is not just about looks or fame. It is about finding someone who can carry a franchise, handle global attention, and bring something fresh to a role that millions of people already have strong opinions about.

Casting Bond is one of the most difficult jobs in Hollywood. The actor has to feel classic enough for longtime fans, but fresh enough for a new audience.

Could the Next James Bond Be an Unknown Actor?

One of the most interesting parts of this story is the growing speculation that the next Bond may not be the biggest name on the list.

Vanity Fair reported that Tony-nominated stage actor Tom Francis recently auditioned for the role, while also noting that filmmaker Denis Villeneuve may be looking for a lesser-known British actor to play 007. (Vanity Fair)

That would make sense historically.

Before Casino Royale, Daniel Craig was respected, but he was not the global superstar he became after playing Bond. His casting was also controversial at first, with some fans questioning whether he fit the traditional idea of James Bond. Over time, Craig’s version of the character became one of the most successful and respected in franchise history.

That is what makes this casting search exciting. The next Bond could be someone audiences already know, or it could be an actor whose life changes overnight.

The Fan Debate Has Already Started

As expected, fans are already debating possible names.

Vanity Fair noted that actors such as Callum Turner, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Jacob Elordi, Henry Cavill, Jack Lowden, Jonathan Bailey, Damson Idris, Harris Dickinson, Regé-Jean Page, Theo James, and Aaron Pierre have all been part of the wider conversation around who could play Bond. However, many of these names are based on speculation, fan discussion, and prediction markets rather than official casting confirmation. (Vanity Fair)

That is exactly why this story is perfect for social media.

Everyone has an opinion.

Some fans want a traditional Bond.
Some want a younger Bond.
Some want a more diverse Bond.
Some want a totally unknown actor.
Some want a proven movie star.

The debate is already bigger than one casting choice. It is about what audiences want from classic franchises in 2026 and beyond.

Why This Casting Search Matters for Actors

For actors, the James Bond search is a reminder that one opportunity can change everything.

A role like Bond can take an actor from respected performer to global superstar. It can open doors to major films, endorsements, awards campaigns, and long-term career opportunities.

But it also shows how competitive major casting can be.

The next James Bond will likely need more than a strong audition. The actor will need screen presence, discipline, physical ability, emotional range, charisma, and the ability to handle worldwide attention.

That is a helpful lesson for rising actors: your next opportunity may not be James Bond, but every audition is a chance to be remembered.

What Actors Can Learn From the James Bond Casting Search

The Bond search shows how important preparation is.

Actors should always be ready before the big opportunity arrives. That means keeping materials updated, improving their craft, and staying visible to casting professionals.

Here are a few takeaways:

  • Keep your headshots current.
  • Update your acting resume regularly.
  • Build a strong online profile.
  • Add your best reel footage.
  • Apply to verified casting opportunities.
  • Continue training and improving your performance skills.
  • Stay professional in every audition, even if the role feels small.

Casting decisions can happen quickly, and opportunity often comes to actors who are ready.

A Major Question: Should Bond Change?

The biggest conversation around the next James Bond is not just “who should play him?”

It is also: how much should the character change?

Bond has been around since Ian Fleming created the character in the 1950s, and the film franchise began with Dr. No in 1962. Entertainment Weekly notes that the franchise was originally guided by producers Albert “Cubby” Broccoli and Harry Saltzman, before later being led by Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson. (EW.com)

Now, with Amazon MGM in control and a new creative team in place, the franchise has a chance to evolve.

That could mean a more emotional Bond. A younger Bond. A more modern Bond. A more grounded Bond. Or a version that honors the classic formula while updating the world around him.

Either way, the next casting announcement will be one of the most watched entertainment stories of the year.

Final Thoughts

The search for the next James Bond is officially underway, and the entertainment industry is watching closely.

For fans, it is a fun debate. For actors, it is a reminder of how powerful the right role can be. For casting professionals, it is one of the most high-pressure casting decisions in modern Hollywood.

The big question remains:

Who should be the next James Bond?

Should Amazon MGM choose a major star, a rising actor, or a fresh face no one sees coming?

One thing is clear: whoever lands the role will step into one of the most iconic characters in film history.

Has the search for the next James Bond officially started?

Yes. Amazon MGM Studios confirmed that “the search for the next James Bond is underway.” The studio also said it will not comment on specific casting details during the process. (007)

Who was the last James Bond?

Daniel Craig was the last actor to play James Bond. His final Bond film was No Time to Die, released in 2021. He previously starred in Casino Royale, Quantum of Solace, Skyfall, and Spectre. (People.com)

Who is directing the next James Bond movie?

Denis Villeneuve is directing the next James Bond film. He is known for movies including Dune, Arrival, and Blade Runner 2049. (007)

Who is writing the next James Bond movie?

Steven Knight is writing the script. Knight is best known as the creator of Peaky Blinders. (007)

Who is casting the next James Bond?

Entertainment Weekly reported that Nina Gold is serving as casting director for the project. Gold has worked on major productions including Game of Thrones, Star Wars: The Force Awakens, Paddington, Prometheus, and Conclave. (EW.com)

Who are the rumored actors for the next James Bond?

However, none of these actors have been officially announced as the next Bond. (Vanity Fair)

Could the next James Bond be an unknown actor?

Yes, it is possible. Vanity Fair reported that filmmaker Denis Villeneuve may be looking for a lesser-known British actor to play Bond. That would follow a tradition of turning respected actors into global stars through the role. (Vanity Fair)

No public open casting call has been announced. Amazon MGM has said it will not comment on specific casting details during the process. Actors should be careful of fake casting notices and only trust official sources or verified casting platforms. (007)

The next Bond actor will help define a new era for the franchise. This is the first major Bond chapter after Daniel Craig’s departure and after Amazon MGM gained creative control over future Bond projects. (People.com)

Actors should stay ready. Big opportunities can come from strong preparation, consistent training, updated materials, and visibility. Even if you are not auditioning for Bond, every role can lead to the next major opportunity.

Artificial intelligence is quickly becoming one of the biggest conversations in Hollywood.

At the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, AI became a major topic across the entertainment industry. Filmmakers, actors, studios, and unions are all asking the same big question: How will AI change the future of movies, TV, and acting?

For actors, this conversation matters. AI is no longer just a tech trend. It is now connected to casting, performances, digital replicas, scripts, voice work, and how studios may create content in the future.

Why AI Is Making Headlines in Entertainment

One of the biggest examples came from filmmaker Steven Soderbergh, whose documentary John Lennon: The Last Interview used Meta’s AI tools to create visual imagery for parts of the film. The project premiered at Cannes and sparked debate about how AI should be used in filmmaking.

Some filmmakers see AI as a new creative tool. Others worry it could reduce opportunities for actors, writers, and crew members.

Actor and filmmaker Seth Rogen also spoke out strongly against using AI for screenwriting, saying that writers who rely on AI are “not writing.” He argued that the creative process is part of what makes storytelling meaningful.

What This Means for Actors

For performers, the biggest concern is not just AI-generated scripts or visuals. It is the use of an actor’s face, voice, body, or likeness without proper consent.

That is why AI protections have become a major issue for SAG-AFTRA and the entertainment industry. Recent agreements and conversations have focused on digital replicas, synthetic performers, and making sure actors are protected as technology continues to grow.

The Academy Awards have also updated rules around AI. According to recent reporting, acting performances must be performed by humans with consent, and screenplays must be human-authored to qualify for certain Oscar categories.

AI May Change Hollywood, But Human Talent Still Matters

AI may help filmmakers move faster, create new visuals, or lower production costs. But acting is still built on emotion, experience, personality, and real human connection.

That is something technology cannot fully replace.

For actors, models, creators, and performers, the key is to stay informed. Understand how AI may affect auditions, contracts, likeness rights, and the types of roles being created.

How Actors Can Prepare

Actors should continue to focus on the things that make them stand out:

  • Keep your headshots and resume updated.
  • Build a strong online profile.
  • Apply to verified casting opportunities.
  • Read contracts carefully before agreeing to digital likeness or voice usage.
  • Stay informed about industry changes involving AI.

Final Thoughts

AI is changing Hollywood, but opportunity is still here.

As the entertainment industry adapts, actors who stay prepared, visible, and professional will be in the best position to succeed. The future of entertainment may include new technology, but casting directors and producers still need real people, real performances, and real stories.

Key Takeaways

  • Jon Favreau says he has a “healthy concern” about AI in Hollywood.
  • The filmmaker believes transparency and responsibility are critical as AI evolves.
  • AI remains one of the entertainment industry’s most divisive topics.
  • Some celebrities strongly oppose AI, while others believe it’s inevitable.
  • The conversation around AI could shape the future of filmmaking, acting, and content creation.

Jon Favreau Discusses AI’s Impact on Hollywood

During an appearance on CBS Sunday Morning, Favreau spoke candidly about artificial intelligence and how technological change is affecting the entertainment industry.

When asked whether he worries about AI advancements, the Marvel director explained that every generation experiences disruption caused by new technology.

“I have a healthy concern about what might come,” Favreau said.

The filmmaker stressed that avoiding innovation entirely is unrealistic. Instead, he believes the focus should be on using AI responsibly and transparently.

According to Favreau, creators and companies need to fully understand the consequences of emerging technology before embracing it too quickly.

Why Transparency Matters

Favreau emphasized that AI discussions should not be limited to Hollywood. He noted that nearly every industry is facing similar challenges as artificial intelligence tools become more powerful and accessible.

He explained that while technology often improves people’s lives, there can also be unintended consequences when innovation moves faster than regulation or ethical discussions.

“Life has improved, but there are always unintended consequences if anything novel is embraced without being thoughtful about it and being measured,” Favreau said.

The director also pointed out that ongoing public conversations are necessary to determine how AI should be integrated into society and creative industries.

AI in Hollywood Remains Deeply Divisive

Artificial intelligence has become one of the most controversial topics in entertainment. As studios explore AI-generated scripts, digital performers, and automated editing tools, many creatives are raising concerns about job security and artistic integrity.

Favreau’s comments arrive during a period when actors, writers, and directors continue to publicly debate the technology.

Celebrities Who Oppose AI

Several major Hollywood figures have criticized AI’s growing influence in entertainment.

Seth Rogen recently called AI-generated creative work “stupid dog shit,” arguing that people should not call themselves writers if they rely heavily on AI tools.

Hacks actress Hannah Einbinder also slammed AI users, referring to them as “losers” during a recent interview.

These criticisms reflect broader concerns among writers, actors, and creators who fear AI could replace human creativity and reduce opportunities in the entertainment industry.

Hollywood Stars Embracing AI Technology

While some stars remain skeptical, others are openly experimenting with AI-driven filmmaking and production tools.

Director Darren Aronofsky and actress Natasha Lyonne have both expressed interest in AI’s creative potential. Meanwhile, stars like Demi Moore, Sandra Bullock, and Reese Witherspoon have acknowledged that AI is likely to become a permanent part of Hollywood’s future.

This divide highlights a growing reality in entertainment: AI is no longer a distant concept. It is already influencing production workflows, visual effects, marketing campaigns, voice technology, and digital content creation.

What AI Could Mean for Actors and Creators

For actors, filmmakers, and content creators, AI presents both opportunities and risks.

Potential Benefits of AI in Entertainment

AI tools may help creators:

  • Speed up video editing and post-production
  • Generate concept art and storyboards
  • Improve visual effects workflows
  • Enhance dubbing and localization
  • Reduce production costs for independent filmmakers

Many creators are also using AI to brainstorm ideas, organize scripts, and streamline repetitive production tasks.

Concerns About AI Replacing Creative Jobs

At the same time, unions and entertainment professionals continue to push for stronger protections against unauthorized AI usage.

Some major concerns include:

  • AI-generated digital likenesses of actors
  • Replacement of writers with AI-generated scripts
  • Loss of creative originality
  • Reduced job opportunities in production
  • Ethical issues around ownership and compensation

These concerns became central issues during the recent Hollywood writers’ and actors’ strikes, where AI protections were heavily negotiated.

Jon Favreau Encourages Staying Informed

Despite his concerns, Favreau made it clear that he believes understanding AI is important.

The filmmaker said he actively follows developments in artificial intelligence to better understand how the technology is evolving.

“I try to stay up on [news regarding AI] as much as I can and try to understand it,” he explained.

His perspective reflects the growing sentiment across Hollywood: AI is coming whether the industry is ready or not, making education and responsible use more important than ever.

The Future of AI in Hollywood

Artificial intelligence is likely to remain one of Hollywood’s biggest conversations for years to come. As filmmakers, actors, and studios continue experimenting with AI tools, the industry will need to balance innovation with ethical responsibility.

For entertainment professionals, staying informed about AI trends may become just as important as keeping up with new casting platforms, production technologies, and digital media opportunities.

Whether embraced or resisted, AI is already changing how movies, television, and online content are created.

And according to Jon Favreau, the key may not be stopping the technology — but learning how to use it responsibly.

item.content:encoded:
Key Takeaways

  • Eddie Murphy banned his children from acting before age 18.
  • He wanted his kids to experience a “normal childhood.”
  • Bella Murphy says the rule made her even more determined to become an actress.
  • Bella made her acting debut in Coming 2 America at age 17.
  • Eddie Murphy insisted Bella audition like every other actor.

Eddie Murphy Wanted His Children to Have a Normal Childhood

In a new interview with PEOPLE, Bella Murphy revealed that she frequently asked her father if she could appear in his films while growing up.

However, Eddie consistently refused.

“He’d always say, ‘No,’ because we have a rule that we can’t act or work until we’re 18 in this industry,’” Bella explained.

The Beverly Hills Cop star reportedly believed childhood should come before Hollywood careers. Rather than exposing his children to the pressures of fame at a young age, he wanted them to enjoy life outside the entertainment industry.

Bella, now 24, says she appreciates her father’s decision more as she gets older.

“He really wanted me to have a normal childhood, which I’m very appreciative of,” she said.

The Rule Made Bella Murphy Want Acting Even More

Ironically, Eddie Murphy’s restriction had the opposite effect on Bella’s ambition.

Instead of discouraging her, the rule made her even more passionate about acting and filmmaking.

“That kind of made me even more obsessed with it,” Bella shared.

Knowing she would eventually be allowed to pursue acting pushed her to prepare early and take the craft seriously.

Bella recalled being fascinated by the entertainment industry from a young age.

“It’s the coolest job ever,” she said. “I want to do that.”

For many aspiring actors, Bella’s story highlights an important lesson: sometimes delayed opportunities can strengthen determination and preparation.

Bella Murphy Knew She Wanted to Act at Age 9

Bella revealed she first realized she wanted to become an actress when she was just nine years old.

Her older sister Bria Murphy also influenced her career goals.

“She wanted to be an actress before I did,” Bella explained.

At first, Bella admitted she was simply copying her older sister. But over time, she realized acting was genuinely her own dream as well.

Growing up around movie sets and one of Hollywood’s biggest comedy stars naturally exposed Bella to filmmaking early on, even if she wasn’t allowed to participate professionally yet.

Bella Murphy Broke Eddie Murphy’s Rule

Despite Eddie Murphy’s no-acting-before-18 policy, Bella technically entered the entertainment industry one year early.

She made her screen debut at age 17 in the 2021 sequel Coming 2 America, where she played the daughter of Eddie Murphy’s iconic character, Prince Akeem.

However, Eddie made it clear that family connections alone would not guarantee his daughter a role.

Eddie Murphy Made Bella Audition Like Everyone Else

During a 2021 appearance on Good Morning America, Eddie Murphy explained that Bella had to earn her role through a real audition process.

“She had to audition for Craig Brewer, who directed the movie,” Eddie said.

The comedy legend emphasized he was not going to hand his daughter an acting career simply because of their family relationship.

“I wasn’t musclin’ my kid into the movie,” he added.

According to Eddie, Bella needed to prove she could deliver a strong performance like any professional actor.

That approach reflects a growing trend among celebrity parents in Hollywood who want their children to establish credibility independently instead of relying solely on nepotism.

Hollywood’s Ongoing Nepotism Debate

Bella Murphy’s story arrives during ongoing conversations about “nepo babies” in Hollywood — a term used to describe children of celebrities who enter the entertainment industry.

While celebrity connections can create opportunities, many audiences and industry professionals increasingly expect actors to demonstrate real talent and work ethic.

Eddie Murphy’s insistence that Bella audition normally may resonate with fans who value merit-based casting.

For aspiring actors and performers, the takeaway is simple: preparation and talent still matter, even when industry connections exist.

Eddie Murphy’s Family

Eddie Murphy is the father of 10 children from several relationships.

His children include:

  • Eric Murphy, 36
  • Christian Murphy, 35
  • Bria Murphy, 36
  • Miles Murphy, 33
  • Shayne Murphy, 31
  • Zola Murphy, 26
  • Bella Murphy, 24
  • Angel Murphy, 19
  • Izzy Murphy, 9
  • Max Murphy, 7

The actor shares children with Paulette McNeely, Tamara Hood, Nicole Mitchell, Melanie Brown (Mel B), and his current wife Paige Butcher.

Despite his massive Hollywood success, Murphy has consistently emphasized family and parenting throughout his career.

What Aspiring Actors Can Learn From Bella Murphy’s Story

Bella Murphy’s journey offers several lessons for young actors and entertainers:

Patience Matters

Not every opportunity has to happen immediately. Spending time developing skills and maturity can create long-term success.

Preparation Is Key

Bella used her waiting period to become more serious about acting before entering the industry professionally.

Talent Still Counts

Even with a famous last name, auditions and performance quality remain essential in Hollywood.

Family Support Can Shape Careers

Eddie Murphy’s parenting style shows that guidance and boundaries can positively influence young performers.

Hollywood Parents Are Becoming More Protective

As social media, streaming platforms, and celebrity culture continue evolving, many Hollywood parents are becoming increasingly cautious about exposing children to fame too early.

The entertainment industry has changed dramatically over the past decade, with young performers facing more online scrutiny than ever before.

Eddie Murphy’s approach reflects a growing mindset among celebrities who prioritize mental health, privacy, and childhood development over early fame.

And for Bella Murphy, the strategy appears to have worked.

What Is Project Casting?

Project Casting is an entertainment career platform built to help actors, models, voiceover talent, content creators, crew members, casting directors, production companies, and brands connect through real job opportunities.

From casting calls and auditions to production jobs, brand campaigns, modeling work, voiceover opportunities, and creator gigs, Project Casting gives people a centralized place to discover opportunities, apply for jobs, build their profile, and grow their career in the entertainment industry.

Our Mission

Project Casting’s mission is to empower individuals to find meaningful employment, build careers, and develop the job skills needed to thrive in the entertainment industry.

Built for Creators. Powered by Opportunities.

If you are an actor, model, content creator, influencer, filmmaker, or performer looking for real entertainment opportunities, Project Casting is designed to help you discover what is available and apply faster.

From Hollywood productions to social media campaigns, Project Casting connects talent with casting directors, production teams, brands, agencies, and companies looking for people for movies, TV shows, commercials, brand campaigns, content creation opportunities, modeling jobs, and more.

Whether you are just starting out or already building a career in entertainment, one of the most common questions people ask is:

What types of casting calls are usually posted on Project Casting?

The answer is simple: Project Casting features a wide range of opportunities across traditional entertainment, digital media, advertising, and the creator economy.

1. Film Casting Calls

Film casting calls are one of the most popular types of opportunities posted on Project Casting.

These can include roles for:

Actors

Background actors

Extras

Stand-ins

Photo doubles

Featured talent

Supporting roles

Independent film talent

Short film talent

Student film talent

Production crew and creative roles

Film casting calls may come from major productions, independent filmmakers, student projects, streaming content, branded films, or local production companies.

Some roles may require acting experience, while others may be open to people with no professional credits. This makes film casting calls a strong starting point for new talent who want to gain on-set experience.

2. TV Show Casting Calls

Project Casting also features casting calls for television productions.

These opportunities may include scripted TV shows, reality TV, docuseries, streaming shows, lifestyle programming, and unscripted entertainment.

Common TV casting opportunities include:

Speaking roles

Background roles

Reality show participants

Game show contestants

Lifestyle show talent

Featured extras

Recurring background talent

Stand-ins

Audience members

Specialty talent

TV casting calls can be especially valuable because productions often need a large number of people for different scenes, locations, and schedules.

For actors and performers, TV work can help build experience, expand a résumé, and create connections in the entertainment industry.

3. Commercial Casting Calls

Commercial casting calls are another major category on Project Casting.

Brands, agencies, and production companies often look for talent to appear in commercials, digital ads, product campaigns, and promotional videos.

Commercial casting calls may include:

TV commercials

Online ads

Social media ads

Product videos

Lifestyle shoots

Brand campaigns

Testimonial-style videos

Retail campaigns

Food and beverage ads

Beauty campaigns

Healthcare and wellness campaigns

Commercial jobs often look for relatable, authentic people who can represent a brand naturally. Many commercial casting calls are open to actors, models, families, kids, seniors, athletes, creators, and everyday people.

This makes commercial work one of the most accessible types of casting opportunities.

4. Modeling Jobs and Photoshoots

Project Casting also posts modeling opportunities for talent interested in print, fashion, lifestyle, beauty, fitness, product, and commercial modeling.

Common modeling jobs may include:

Fashion shoots

Lifestyle photoshoots

Product modeling

Beauty campaigns

Fitness modeling

E-commerce modeling

Runway opportunities

Editorial shoots

Promotional modeling

Brand ambassador work

Not every modeling job requires runway experience or agency representation. Many brands look for real people, diverse looks, niche styles, and authentic personalities.

This is especially true for lifestyle and commercial modeling, where brands want talent who can connect with everyday consumers.

5. UGC Creator Jobs

UGC, or user-generated content, has become one of the fastest-growing categories in the creator economy.

On Project Casting, brands may post UGC creator jobs for people who can create authentic videos, product reviews, tutorials, unboxings, testimonials, social media clips, and short-form content.

UGC opportunities may include:

Product review videos

TikTok-style content

Instagram Reels

Unboxing videos

Skincare routines

Fashion try-ons

App demos

Food and beverage content

Home and lifestyle content

Fitness content

Voiceover-style UGC videos

Paid ad creatives

The best part is that many UGC jobs do not require a huge following. Brands often care more about your ability to create natural, engaging content than your follower count.

If you are comfortable on camera, know how to film short videos, and can communicate clearly, UGC creator jobs can be a strong opportunity.

6. Influencer Campaigns and Brand Deals

Project Casting also connects creators and influencers with brand campaigns.

These opportunities may include paid partnerships, sponsored posts, product promotions, ambassador campaigns, and social media collaborations.

Influencer casting calls may look for:

Nano-influencers

Micro-influencers

Lifestyle creators

Fashion creators

Beauty creators

Fitness creators

Food creators

Travel creators

Parenting creators

College creators

Gaming creators

Local creators

Niche community creators

Many brands are no longer only looking for celebrities or creators with millions of followers. They are often looking for authentic voices with engaged audiences.

That means creators with smaller followings may still qualify for paid brand deals if their content, audience, and style match the campaign.

7. Voiceover Jobs

Voiceover casting calls are another type of opportunity that may appear on Project Casting.

Voiceover work can be used for commercials, animations, social media ads, explainer videos, podcasts, audiobooks, corporate videos, apps, games, and online campaigns.

Voiceover jobs may include:

Commercial voiceovers

Narration

Character voices

Explainer videos

Brand videos

Social media ads

Podcast intros

Training videos

Animation projects

E-learning content

Voiceover opportunities are especially useful for performers who have strong vocal range, clear delivery, or unique character voices.

Some jobs may require a professional home recording setup, while others may provide studio instructions.

8. Background Acting and Extra Work

Background acting is one of the most common ways people get started in the entertainment industry.

Project Casting often features opportunities for background actors and extras for film, TV, commercials, music videos, and live productions.

Background casting calls may look for:

Pedestrians

Restaurant guests

Office workers

Students

Party guests

Concert crowds

Sports fans

Airport travelers

Hospital staff

Police officers

Military types

Upscale event guests

Families

Cars and drivers

Specialty extras

Background work can help new talent learn how sets operate, meet other performers, and gain practical experience.

While extra work may not always involve speaking lines, it can be a valuable way to get comfortable in a professional production environment.

9. Music Video Casting Calls

Music video casting calls may also appear on Project Casting.

These jobs can include dancers, models, actors, background talent, featured performers, cars, stylists, and specialty talent.

Music video opportunities may look for:

Dancers

Models

Featured talent

Background performers

Couples

Party scenes

Luxury lifestyle talent

Athletes

Unique looks

Music videos often move quickly, so applying early and having a complete profile can help talent stand out.

10. Live Event and Promotional Jobs

Some casting calls focus on live event jobs, promotional campaigns, brand activations, and experiential marketing.

These opportunities may include:

Brand ambassadors

Event staff

Product demonstrators

Promotional models

Trade show talent

Street team members

Convention talent

Festival staff

Launch event talent

Host and emcee roles

These jobs can be great for people who are outgoing, professional, reliable, and comfortable interacting with the public.

Promotional jobs are also a strong fit for actors, models, creators, and performers who want flexible paid opportunities.

11. Reality TV and Unscripted Casting

Reality TV casting is another category often associated with entertainment platforms.

These opportunities may look for real people with interesting stories, unique lifestyles, strong personalities, or specific life experiences.

Reality and unscripted casting calls may include:

Dating shows

Competition shows

Lifestyle shows

Home renovation shows

Docuseries

Family shows

Business shows

Food shows

Travel shows

Social experiment shows

Makeover shows

Reality TV casting is often less about acting experience and more about personality, authenticity, and story.

If you have a unique background, bold point of view, or compelling life experience, reality casting calls may be worth exploring.

12. Crew, Production, and Filmmaker Opportunities

Project Casting is not only for on-camera talent. Some opportunities may also support filmmakers, crew members, and production professionals.

These may include:

Production assistants

Camera operators

Makeup artists

Wardrobe stylists

Photographers

Videographers

Editors

Directors

Producers

Social media content teams

Creative freelancers

Why Project Casting Is Different

Project Casting is built for the modern entertainment industry.

Today, opportunities are not limited to traditional acting auditions. Brands need UGC creators. Streaming platforms need background talent. Commercial productions need actors and models. Social media campaigns need influencers. Production companies need crew. Filmmakers need collaborators.

Project Casting brings many of these opportunities into one platform.

Instead of searching across social media, random job boards, and scattered casting posts, creators can browse opportunities, build a profile, and apply to roles that match their location, skills, look, experience, and interests.

Your current location
Recent photos
Relevant experience
Skills and talents
Acting, modeling, or content creation background
Special abilities
A short professional bio
Accurate contact information

A strong profile helps casting teams understand who you are and why you may be a good fit.

Even if you are new, that is okay. Many opportunities are open to beginners. What matters is that your profile is honest, polished, and easy to review.

What Types of People Can Find Opportunities on Project Casting?

Project Casting is useful for many different types of talent, including:

Actors
Models
Background actors
Extras
Voiceover artists
UGC creators
Influencers
Content creators
Filmmakers
Production crew
Dancers
Athletes

Seniors
Specialty performers
Brand ambassadors
Everyday people

The entertainment industry needs all kinds of people. You do not always need to look a certain way, live in Los Angeles, or have years of experience.

Many casting calls are looking for real people, authentic personalities, specific skills, unique styles, or local talent.

Final Answer: What Types of Casting Calls Are Usually Posted on Project Casting?

Project Casting usually features casting calls and job opportunities across film, TV, commercials, modeling, UGC content, influencer campaigns, voiceover, background acting, music videos, live events, brand activations, reality TV, and production work.

In other words, Project Casting is more than a traditional casting call website. It is an opportunity hub for actors, models, creators, influencers, filmmakers, brands, and entertainment professionals.

Whether you want to get on set, create content for brands, book a commercial, land a modeling job, find voiceover work, or grow your entertainment career, Project Casting can help you discover opportunities in one place.

Create your Project Casting profile, browse casting calls, and start applying to opportunities that match your goals.

Your next role, brand deal, production job, or paid creator opportunity could be waiting.

Let’s get started.

FAQ

What kinds of casting calls are on Project Casting?

Project Casting features casting calls for film, TV, commercials, modeling, UGC content, influencer campaigns, voiceover, background acting, music videos, live events, and more.

Not always. Some roles require experience, but many casting calls are open to beginners, background actors, creators, models, and real people.

FKA Twigs to Play Joséphine Baker in Upcoming Biopic

Grammy-nominated artist and actress FKA Twigs is officially set to portray legendary entertainer and activist Joséphine Baker in a highly anticipated new biopic from acclaimed filmmaker Maïmouna Doucouré.

The untitled film is backed by Studiocanal and is expected to begin filming this fall. The project was officially announced ahead of the Cannes Film Festival, where Studiocanal will launch worldwide sales for the movie.

The Joséphine Baker biopic will explore the extraordinary life and career of one of the most influential performers and civil rights figures of the 20th century.

Maïmouna Doucouré to Write and Direct

The film will be written and directed by Maïmouna Doucouré, the award-winning filmmaker behind Netflix’s “Cuties.” Doucouré will also produce the project through her Bien Ou Bien Prods. banner alongside Studiocanal and CPB Films.

In a statement, Doucouré shared her passion for bringing Joséphine Baker’s story to the screen, describing Baker as fearless, modern, and deeply complex.

The filmmaker explained that the movie aims to explore Baker’s contradictions, courage, struggles, and relentless fight for dignity and equality.

FKA Twigs Calls Joséphine Baker an Inspiration

FKA Twigs expressed excitement about portraying the legendary icon, calling Joséphine Baker a visionary whose impact continues to resonate worldwide.

The singer and actress shared that she looks forward to portraying Baker’s triumphs, talent, heroism, and emotional journey on screen.

Twigs continues expanding her acting career following her appearance in A24’s “Mother Mary,” and her casting has already generated significant buzz throughout Hollywood.

The Legacy of Joséphine Baker

Born in St. Louis in 1906, Joséphine Baker rose to international fame after moving to Paris in 1925. She quickly became one of Europe’s most celebrated entertainers during the Jazz Age thanks to her groundbreaking performances as a dancer, singer, and actress.

However, Baker’s legacy extended far beyond entertainment.

During World War II, she worked with the French Resistance and supported Allied efforts against fascism. Later, she became a major voice in the American Civil Rights Movement during the 1950s and 1960s.

Today, Joséphine Baker remains a symbol of artistic innovation, courage, and activism, making this biopic one of the most anticipated film projects currently in development.

Baker’s Family Is Supporting the Film

The Joséphine Baker biopic is being developed with support from Baker’s sons, Jean-Claude Bouillon Baker and Brian Bouillon Baker, as well as members of the “Rainbow Tribe,” the name Baker gave to her adopted children.

Their involvement is expected to help bring authenticity and emotional depth to the film.

Meet the Casting Directors Behind the Joséphine Baker Biopic

The upcoming Joséphine Baker movie has assembled an impressive casting team with experience across major studio films, television productions, and acclaimed international cinema.

Joanna Levinger Casting

Joanna Levinger Casting is one of the casting directors for this project. Joanna Levinger is known for her work on:

  • Happy Gilmore 2 (2025)
  • Dark in Berlin (2024)
  • The Residence (2025)

Her experience in both film and television makes her a strong addition to the project’s casting department.

Marie-France Michel

Casting director Marie-France Michel is also associated with the production. Her credits include:

  • The Count of Monte Cristo (2024)
  • The Specials (2019)
  • The Intouchables (2011)

Michel is widely respected for her contributions to internationally acclaimed French productions.

Nina Morille

Nina Morille is another casting professional attached to the Joséphine Baker biopic. Her previous projects include:

  • Serial Bad Weddings (2014)
  • C’est la vie! (2017)
  • The Crew (2015)

Morille is known for casting successful ensemble-driven productions.

Caroline Pommert-Allegante

Caroline Pommert-Allegante is also part of the casting department for the project. Her credits include:

  • Anyone But You (2023)
  • Star Wars: Episode IX – The Rise of Skywalker (2019)
  • Ms. Marvel (2022)

Her experience with major studio franchises and streaming productions brings additional industry expertise to the film.

Why This Film Could Create Opportunities for Actors

As production prepares to begin this fall, many actors and performers are already watching closely for potential casting opportunities connected to the Joséphine Baker biopic.

Large-scale biographical films often require:

  • Featured speaking roles
  • Supporting actors
  • Background talent
  • Dancers
  • Musicians
  • Period-specific extras
  • Stand-ins and photo doubles

Because Joséphine Baker’s life spanned multiple decades and countries, the production could potentially seek diverse talent from various backgrounds throughout development and filming.

Josephine Baker Biopic Starring FKA Twigs Principal Role Open Casting Call

Young Actress to Portray Josephine Baker at Age 12

Job Description
A production is casting a young actress to portray Josephine Baker at 12 years old for an upcoming project filming in the UK or Europe. Casting directors are seeking talented young performers with dance experience, strong comedic timing, and the ability to perform with an American accent. This is a great opportunity for rising young actors interested in portraying an iconic historical figure.

Job Responsibilities

  • Portray a young Josephine Baker in scripted scenes
  • Perform with confidence and emotional authenticity on camera
  • Utilize dance skills during rehearsals or filming if required
  • Follow direction from the production and creative team

Requirements

  • Talent ages 12–16
  • Black or mixed ethnicity preferred
  • Must be able to perform an American accent
  • Dance experience required
  • Strong comedic timing and charisma preferred
  • Height must not exceed 155 cm
  • Must be based in the UK or Europe

Compensation

  • Paid acting opportunity
  • Chance to portray an iconic historical figure
  • Work with a professional film production team

Click here to apply now!

Studiocanal Planning Global Release

Studiocanal will distribute the film theatrically across several major territories, including:

  • United Kingdom
  • France
  • Germany
  • Italy
  • Benelux
  • Poland
  • Australia
  • New Zealand

Studiocanal CEO Anna Marsh praised both FKA Twigs and Maïmouna Doucouré, describing the project as ambitious, authentic, and deeply meaningful.

Why the Joséphine Baker Biopic Matters

Interest in historical biopics continues to grow across Hollywood, especially projects focused on influential women who reshaped entertainment, politics, and culture.

With FKA Twigs starring and Maïmouna Doucouré directing, the Joséphine Baker biopic already has strong awards-season potential and could become a defining project for everyone involved.

The film also introduces a new generation to Baker’s groundbreaking contributions to entertainment and social justice.

Looking for Entertainment Industry Opportunities?

From major studio productions to independent films and streaming projects, the entertainment industry continues creating exciting opportunities for actors, dancers, models, and creatives worldwide.

Ready to find your next opportunity in film and television? Explore the latest casting calls and entertainment jobs on Project Casting and apply today!

Casting directors play a crucial role in shaping a film’s success—especially for a character-driven story like 13 Going on 30. The chemistry between actors is key, and the right casting team can make or break a reboot.

Recap of the Original ‘13 Going on 30’

Released in 2004, 13 Going on 30 became an instant classic. The story follows Jenna Rink, a 13-year-old girl who, after a humiliating birthday party, wishes to become “thirty, flirty, and thriving.”

She wakes up as her 30-year-old self and quickly realizes adulthood isn’t what she imagined. As Jenna navigates her new life, she discovers she’s become someone she doesn’t recognize—and must find her way back to who she truly is.

The film starred:

It also featured a strong supporting cast that helped make the story unforgettable.

What to Expect From the New Version

Details about the reboot’s storyline remain under wraps. It’s unclear whether the film will follow the original plot or introduce a fresh take inspired by the same concept.

With Jennifer Garner involved behind the scenes, there is strong hope that the reboot will maintain the heart and charm of the original while appealing to modern audiences.

The Colonel: Legendary Fort Worth Football Coach Gets the Hollywood Treatment

A powerful new feature film titled The Colonel is bringing the inspiring true story of legendary Fort Worth football coach Lieutenant Colonel R.C. “Rocky” Rosacker to audiences everywhere. The upcoming movie shines a spotlight on the beloved mentor who transformed the lives of countless students at Fort Worth Country Day School (FWCD) through leadership, discipline, and encouragement.

For generations of Fort Worth families, Rosacker’s influence extended far beyond football. Now, after more than 15 years in development, The Colonel is officially moving forward with filming in Texas — and the project already has major Hollywood talent attached.

Who Was Lieutenant Colonel R.C. “Rocky” Rosacker?

Fort Worth Country Day School was founded in 1963, and Colonel Rosacker joined the school in 1969 as both a history teacher and football coach. Over the years, he became one of the most respected mentors in the Fort Worth community.

Known affectionately as “The Colonel,” Rosacker inspired students during one of the most turbulent periods in American history. From the Vietnam War and Civil Rights Movement to the Apollo 11 moon landing and Beatlemania, Rosacker helped guide young people through a rapidly changing cultural landscape.

Writer and director Tim Williams, a former FWCD student, credits Rosacker with profoundly shaping his life.

According to Williams, Rosacker never bragged about his own accomplishments. Instead, he focused on helping students realize their full potential. His unique blend of discipline, leadership, and encouragement made him a legendary figure on campus.

How The Colonel Became a Passion Project

Tim Williams has spent the last 15 years developing The Colonel into a feature film. For Williams, the project is deeply personal.

The filmmaker says Rosacker’s mentorship changed the direction of his life and inspired him to pursue a meaningful future. Williams wanted to capture the emotional impact Rosacker had on generations of students and share it with a much broader audience.

At the heart of The Colonel is a universal story about mentorship, belief, and transformation — themes that continue to resonate with audiences today.

Neal McDonough Stars in The Colonel

Hollywood actor Neal McDonough has officially signed on to star in The Colonel, bringing additional momentum to the production.

McDonough is widely recognized for his work in major film and television projects, including:

  • Band of Brothers
  • Yellowstone
  • Tulsa King
  • The Shift
  • Homestead

In addition to starring in the film, McDonough is also producing the project. His connection to Angel Studios — the company behind the massive box office success Sound of Freedom — could help position The Colonel for a wide audience release.

After reading the screenplay, McDonough reportedly told Williams:

“Tim, I’m Neal McDonough. I’m the Colonel. We’re going to do this.”

The actor has also emphasized that Hollywood is increasingly searching for uplifting, faith-based, and inspirational stories — making The Colonel especially timely.

Who Are the Casting Directors Behind The Colonel?

As excitement continues to build around The Colonel, the film’s casting team is also drawing attention. The project features experienced industry professionals responsible for helping bring the story’s characters to life through authentic and carefully selected talent.

One of the casting directors attached to The Colonel is Jacqueline Gibbs, a casting director, set decorator, and actress known for her work on productions including Amazin’ Grace (2014), The Colonel (2016), and Bullied (2012). Gibbs has experience working across multiple areas of film production, giving her a strong understanding of both performance and storytelling.

Another casting team involved in the project is Michael Druck Casting, a respected casting company known for working on film and television productions across the entertainment industry. Their involvement signals that The Colonel is assembling an experienced and professional casting department as production ramps up in Texas.

Casting directors play a major role in shaping a film’s emotional impact. From reviewing auditions to selecting actors who can authentically portray real-life personalities, the casting process is especially important for a character-driven story like The Colonel.

Filming Locations and Casting Details for The Colonel

Production for The Colonel is expected to begin in Fort Worth and Austin, Texas.

The filmmakers are currently casting youth roles for the project, creating exciting opportunities for young actors interested in appearing in a major feature film. With filming set in Texas, local talent may have a unique opportunity to participate in the production.

As buzz surrounding The Colonel continues to grow, industry insiders are already paying attention to the film’s inspirational message and strong creative team.

Why The Colonel Could Become a Must-Watch Inspirational Film

Faith-based and inspirational films have seen a major resurgence in Hollywood in recent years. Audiences continue to support uplifting stories rooted in perseverance, mentorship, family, and personal growth.

With Neal McDonough attached, Texas-based production underway, and a heartfelt true story at its center, The Colonel has the potential to become one of the most talked-about inspirational sports dramas currently in development.

For Fort Worth locals, the film also serves as a tribute to a beloved community figure whose impact still lives on today.

Final Thoughts

The Colonel is more than just a football movie. It’s a story about mentorship, leadership, and the power one person can have on an entire generation.

As filming begins in Texas, excitement surrounding the project continues to build — especially among those who experienced Colonel Rosacker’s influence firsthand.

For aspiring actors, this is also an exciting reminder that inspirational independent films continue creating new opportunities in the entertainment industry.

Olivia Wilde to Direct A24’s TV Adaptation of The Candy House

Fans of Jennifer Egan’s work have exciting news to look forward to. The Candy House, the bestselling sequel to A Visit from the Goon Squad, is officially being developed into a television series by A24, with Olivia Wilde attached to direct.

As buzz continues to grow, The Candy House is quickly becoming one of the most anticipated TV adaptations in development.

What Is The Candy House About?

The Candy House is Jennifer Egan’s 2022 novel and a follow-up to her Pulitzer Prize-winning book A Visit from the Goon Squad. The original novel, which won the 2011 Pulitzer Prize, tells 13 interconnected stories centered around music executive Bennie Salazar and his assistant Sasha.

In The Candy House, Egan revisits familiar characters while introducing a new generation, expanding the story’s universe. The novel explores themes of memory, identity, and technology, making it especially relevant for modern audiences—and a strong candidate for a layered, prestige TV adaptation.

Olivia Wilde Steps Into Television

Olivia Wilde is set to direct the series and will also serve as an executive producer alongside Jennifer Fox. This marks Wilde’s first major television directing project, further solidifying her growing influence behind the camera.

Her involvement signals that The Candy House adaptation will likely aim for both critical acclaim and mainstream appeal, given her track record with character-driven storytelling.

A24 Continues Its Momentum

A24 has officially optioned the rights to both The Candy House and A Visit from the Goon Squad. Known for producing award-winning and culturally impactful content, A24 has expanded its dominance from film into television.

With recent successes like Beef, the studio has proven its ability to deliver compelling, high-quality series—raising expectations for this upcoming adaptation.

Who Is Casting The Candy House?

Casting is a critical component of bringing The Candy House’s interconnected stories to life, and one of the casting teams attached to the project is Caballero Casting.

Caballero Casting has built a strong reputation in the entertainment industry for working on major film and television productions. Known for discovering fresh talent and assembling dynamic ensembles, their involvement suggests the series will feature a thoughtfully selected cast that reflects the depth and diversity of the source material.

While the full casting team has not yet been officially announced, the inclusion of Caballero Casting points to a high level of care and expertise behind the scenes. As casting details continue to emerge, this project is expected to create exciting opportunities for both established actors and newcomers.

Olivia Wilde’s Recent Success

Olivia Wilde has become one of Hollywood’s most in-demand directors. She recently directed, produced, and starred in Don’t Worry Darling, which premiered at the Venice Film Festival and opened at No. 1 at the U.S. box office, earning nearly $90 million worldwide.

Her directorial debut, Booksmart (2019), received widespread acclaim and multiple award nominations, further establishing her as a strong creative voice in the industry.

In addition to The Candy House, Wilde is also developing a Marvel project centered on Spider-Woman and a holiday comedy film for Universal.

Why The Candy House Adaptation Matters

The adaptation of The Candy House reflects a growing trend of turning complex, literary works into prestige television. With its innovative narrative structure and timely themes, the story is well-suited for a modern TV audience.

Backed by A24 and led by Olivia Wilde, this series has the potential to become a standout project in the evolving streaming landscape.
